title: Never Say 'I'll Do It Tomorrow' Without This

meta.name: v5_k18_03_in-sha-allah
meta.title: Never Say 'I'll Do It Tomorrow' Without This

lines.text: Never say 'I'll do it tomorrow' without this.
Allāh teaches how to talk about tomorrow:
And never say of anything, Indeed, I will do that tomorrow.

quran.ar: وَلَا تَقُولَنَّ لِشَا۟یۡءٍ إِنِّی فَاعِلࣱ ذَ ٰ⁠لِكَ غَدًا

lines.text: Except [when adding], If Allāh wills. And remember your Lord when you forget [it] and say, Perhaps my Lord will guide me to what is nearer than this to right conduct.

quran.ar: إِلَّاۤ أَن یَشَاۤءَ ٱللَّهُۚ وَٱذۡكُر رَّبَّكَ إِذَا نَسِیتَ وَقُلۡ عَسَىٰۤ أَن یَهۡدِیَنِ رَبِّی لِأَقۡرَبَ مِنۡ هَـٰذَا رَشَدࣰا

lines.text: Tomorrow is not in your hands.
Add the words, and mean them.
And if you forget, remember Him.
